events.title: Issue with spend limits
events.summary: Oct 7 , 21:23 UTC Resolved - We have identified an issue which resulted in some organizations to be incorrectly paused for having reached their spend limit, resulting in refused requests on the Claude API, Claude.ai, Claude Code, Claude Security, and Claude Cowork. This is now resolved.

events.title: Elevated errors loading usage data on platform.claude.com
events.summary: Oct 7 , 02:33 UTC Resolved - This incident has been resolved. From 17:00 PT on October 6 / 00:00 UTC on October 7 to 18:40 PT on October 6 / 01:40 UTC on October 7, many requests to load usage data on the platform.claude.com Usage page and the Admin API usage report returned errors. Oct 7 , 01:20 UTC Investigating - We are investigating elevated errors loading usage data on the platform.claude.com Usage page and the Admin API usage report endpoint since 5 PM PT. Messages API requests are not affected. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

events.title: Remote control for local agents
events.summary: You can now see and reply to the local agents running on your computer from the Cursor iOS app.

events.title: Rollouts and Security Review
events.summary: Today we're launching two Cursor bots for the last mile of shipping code. Rollouts watches every change as it deploys and reports its health per environment. Security Review reports exploitable bugs on every pull request.

events.title: Cursor Projects
events.summary: Today we're launching Projects in Cursor. Projects lets you take on larger bodies of work, such as a feature, a migration, or a full app. It maintains context over months of work, delegates tasks to thousands of subagents, and performs recurring work without being prompted.

events.title: Self-hosted machines
events.summary: Cursor supports self-hosted machines , which let you keep tool execution entirely in your own network.

events.title: Start from scratch, without a repo
events.summary: Cloud Agents no longer require a connected GitHub or other third-party SCM provider to get started. Prompt from the get-go, then save your work to a Cursor Origin repo.

events.title: Building on our commitment to American scientific discovery
Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
events.summary: Our fastest, cheapest, and most capable small model yet. It’s designed for high-volume, cost-sensitive work.

events.title: Agent-Controlled Forgetting for Tool-Using Agents: Reversible Context Curation in Practice
events.summary:
arXiv:2610.10590v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Tool-using agents repeatedly carry observations whose useful content can be much smaller than their original payload. We study agent-controlled forgetting: the acting model selects previously observed tool results, replaces each with a short note at its original position, and retains the exact original in a recoverable archive. A Python harness exposes batch archival and explicit recovery without task-specific model training, while protecting user instructions and assistant messages from these operations. events.title: The Harness as the Only Mutable Surface: Compliance-Bounded Self-Evolution of LLM Agents in Credit Pipelines, with a Measured Admission Gate
events.summary:

Abstract: Self-improving LLM agents can adapt a credit pipeline to a changed rule, but an agent that rewrites itself destroys the artefact a supervisor reviews: a named change, a recorded test, an approval. ## What's changed
- Added a `code` key to the Claude apps gateway's `managed.policies[]`: the same settings as `cli`, also applied in Claude Desktop's Code tab; beside `desktop`, it turns on Claude Desktop's gateway mode
- Added `autoCompactWindow` to subagent frontmatter and `--agents` definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main conversation's window
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL` to run every workflow agent on one model while other subagents keep theirs
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer maximum delay…

events.title: v2.1.295
events.summary:
## What's changed
- Added `onFailure: "block"` for command and HTTP hooks: a hook that can't start, times out, or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through
- Added Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) support: terminals that implement it can show whether Claude Code is working, waiting on you, or done
- Added quoted text to the `/copy` picker, so a drafted message copies without its `>` markers

events.title: v2.1.294
events.summary:
## What's changed
- Fixed `prompt` and `agent` hooks written as instructions (such as "Block commands that...") allowing what they should block
- Improved how `prompt` hooks on Stop and SubagentStop written as instructions (such as "Carry on if the build is broken") are judged, so Claude is less likely to stop early

events.title: v2.1.293
events.summary:

- Added Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`), now the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok ($0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K)

- Added `isDeferred` to `$.tool.register` for mods: `false` lists the tool's schema in the prompt from the start instead of behind tool search
